title: A Missed Train Connection
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: Travellers decide how to continue after a delayed arrival.

transcript.text: Our train is twenty minutes late, so we will miss the connection. The next direct service is at seven; we expected to be home by six.
A train through the northern stop leaves in ten minutes. It takes longer, and the platform change is quick.
I prefer the later direct train. We have seats booked, and changing platforms with our bags sounds stressful.
I will check whether our ticket is valid on the later train. If not, we can ask the help desk because the delay was not our choice.
I will message our ride that we will arrive after seven, so they can wait at home.

questions.prompt: Why will the travellers miss their connection?
options: Their train is running twenty minutes late.
They have too many bags to carry.
questions.explanation: The first traveller says the train is twenty minutes late and that this makes them miss the connection.

questions.prompt: Why does Traveller A prefer the later direct service?
options: They do not want to rush between platforms with their bags.
It is the only route with reserved seats.
The northern route has been cancelled.
They need to buy food at the next station.
questions.explanation: They say the alternative requires a quick platform change and would be stressful with their bags.

options: Whether the station sells luggage covers
Whether there is a bus to the northern stop
Whether the meeting point has changed
Whether the ticket can be used on the later train
questions.explanation: Traveller B says they will check if the ticket is valid on the later service.

questions.prompt: What will Traveller A do about the person meeting them?
options: Ask them to come to the station sooner
Tell them the arrival will be later
Cancel the meeting without an explanation
Ask them to buy another ticket
questions.explanation: They plan to message that they will arrive after seven and the person can wait at home.
